mean = te.compute((batch, features), lambda i, k: total[i, k] / samples.astype("float32"), name="mean")
centered = te.compute((batch, samples, features), lambda i, j, k: X[i, j, k] - mean[i, k], name="centered")
sample = te.reduce_axis((0, samples), "sample")
v22 = te.compute((batch, features, features), lambda i0, i1, i2: te.sum(centered[i0, sample, i1] * centered[i0, sample, i2] * (centered[i0, sample, i1] * centered[i0, sample, i2]), axis=sample), name="v22")
k = te.reduce_axis((0, features), "k")
ell = te.reduce_axis((0, features), "ell")
fourthsum = te.compute((batch,), lambda i: te.sum(v22[i, k, ell], axis=k, ell), name="fourthsum")
sample = te.reduce_axis((0, samples), "sample")
covsum = te.compute((batch, features, features), lambda i0, i1, i2: te.sum(centered[i0, sample, i1] * centered[i0, sample, i2], axis=sample), name="covsum")
cov = te.compute((batch, features, features), lambda i, k, ell: covsum[i, k, ell] / samples.astype("float32"), name="cov")
k = te.reduce_axis((0, features), "k")
ell = te.reduce_axis((0, features), "ell")
norm = te.compute((batch,), lambda i: te.sum(cov[i, k, ell] * cov[i, k, ell], axis=k, ell), name="norm")
feature = te.reduce_axis((0, features), "feature")
trace = te.compute((batch,), lambda i: te.sum(cov[i, feature, feature], axis=feature), name="trace")
mu = te.compute((batch,), lambda i: trace[i] / features.astype("float32"), name="mu")
delta = te.compute((batch,), lambda i: norm[i] / features.astype("float32") - mu[i] * mu[i], name="delta")
beta = te.compute((batch,), lambda i: tir.min((fourthsum[i] / samples.astype("float32") - norm[i]) / (features.astype("float32") * samples.astype("float32")), delta[i]), name="beta")
